GBrain now records Gate 47 as the site for the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply, and the earlier Dock 23 note is withdrawn. I replied in Pree's #central-team thread to confirm the update.

- **What changed:** I saved Gate 47 under Marrow Agrisupply, citing Pree's correction, and marked the Dock 23 entry as expired. Before the update, GBrain only had that one Dock 23 entry for the account, so no other copy of the wrong value is left.
- **Still private:** like the first note, the new one is saved only in Pree's member memory, so the rest of the team can't look it up there.
- **Not changed:** my first #central-team reply still says Dock 23. I didn't edit it, but my new reply in the same channel makes the correction.
